name: join-meeting
tagline_zh: 当老板说“这个会你替我开”，别慌。你的AI替身能进Zoom、Meet、Teams，带语音和画面，还能被插话打断。
tagline_en: Your AI twin joins Zoom, Meet, or Teams with voice & video—can be interrupted, speaks for you. You stay on mute.
desc_en: AgentCall (agentcall.dev) — Join a video meeting (Google Meet, Teams, Zoom) as an AI bot with voice and visual presence. Supports audio-only mode with voice intelligence (barge-in, interruptions), text-to-speech mode, and webpage modes for custom UI. Use when asked to join a call, attend a meeting, or participate in a video conference.
why_zh: 同类只会转录音频，它却能以真实参会者身份出现，支持语音打断和自定义界面，让AI不再只是旁听。
why_en: Unlike bots that just transcribe, it appears as a real participant with voice, handles interruptions, and even custom UI—AI that.
